statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The case diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.5
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and evaluate for significant bradycardia or pauses that may correlate with reported symptomatic episodes
The current denial is based on reason code CO-197
The denial concerns missing prior authorization
